items.t: Can you still vote by mail? Changes and dates to know for the midterm elections
items.x: Voters returning mail-in ballots face a patchwork of state deadlines for the midterm elections. Here's what to know.

items.t: Greater Jacksonville Agricultural Fair unveils new 82-acre venue with amphitheater on Westside
items.x: After 70 years downtown, the Greater Jacksonville Agricultural Fair now has a new Westside home with 82 acres and a 10,000-seat amphitheater.

items.t: Grand jury refuses to indict former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson, sources say
items.x: The Justice Department has failed to secure a grand jury indictment against a former White House staffer who testified against President Donald Trump.

items.t: Hunter Biden laptop issue resurfaces as judge scolds prosecutors over case against ex-FBI officials
items.x: A federal judge scolded prosecutors over a criminal case involving two ex-FBI officials and a laptop the Justice Department says belonged to Hunter Biden.

items.t: Jacksonville Housing Authority board votes unanimously to terminate CEO
items.x: Until a permanent CEO is found, Rosalyn Phillips will serve as acting CEO of JHA.

items.t: T-wolves' Anthony Edwards needs procedure on right knee, will miss several weeks, AP source says
items.x: Minnesota guard Anthony Edwards will need an arthroscopic procedure to alleviate issues with his right knee and will miss several weeks, a person with knowledge of the matter said Tuesday.

items.t: 'Healthy and fun': City of St. Augustine to launch new bikeshare program
items.x: The program will see 90 bicycles, 80 pedal and 10 pedal-assisted, distributed across St. Augustine.

items.t: Senator Ashley Moody secures $11 million grant for Port of Fernandina
items.x: The Federal Port Infrastructure Development Program provided $11 million in grant funds that support flood mitigation and dock projects at the Port of Fernandina.

items.t: Arsenal embarrassed in penalty-shootout loss to 4th-tier Fleetwood in English League Cup stunner
items.x: Arsenal has lost to fourth-tier Fleetwood Town in a penalty shootout in one of the biggest upsets in the 66-year history of the English League Cup.

items.t: Grand jury refuses to indict former White House aide Cassidy Hutchinson, AP sources say
items.x: The Justice Department has failed to secure a grand jury indictment against a former White House staffer who testified against President Donald Trump before a House committee investigating the Jan. 6, 2021, U.S. Capitol insurrection.

items.t: Brewers fans flock to the Trop, eager to celebrate the franchise's first World Series title
items.x: Brewers fans are flocking to Tropicana Field in hopes of seeing their team win a World Series title.

items.t: Florida man arrested for allegedly robbing bank wearing 'old man' mask, DOJ says
items.x: A Florida man, previously convicted of multiple bank robberies, faces new charges after police say he wore a prosthetic "old man" mask to rob two banks.

items.t: The 49ers bring back DeForest Buckner in trade with the Colts
items.x: The San Francisco 49ers are bringing back three-time Pro Bowl defensive tackle DeForest Buckner after acquiring their former first-round pick in a trade with Indianapolis.

items.t: Alexander brothers each get 30 years in prison after women spoke of being drugged and raped by them
items.x: Three brothers convicted of exploiting their wealth and access to luxury real estate to drug and rape dozens of women have been sentenced to 30 years each in prison.

items.t: Satellite company plans to test giant mirror in space for sunlight on demand
items.x: Environmental groups are sounding the alarm on Reflect Orbital’s plans to light up nighttime areas on the Earth.

items.t: No more stale cereal: Cheerios adds resealable bag inside boxes
items.x: A popular cereal brand is giving customers what they want: resealable bags inside their cereal boxes.

items.t: King Charles III arrives in Bahamas for official Caribbean trip as slavery reparation demands grow
items.x: King Charles III has arrived in the Bahamas as part of a nine-day trip to the Caribbean, where he faces calls for an apology and slavery reparations.

items.t: Clay County teacher shouldn't be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk's death, court suggests
items.x: The judge recommended dismissing the misconduct case against Kelly Brock-Sanchez, an ESE teacher at Ridgeview Elementary School, over a post she made on Facebook.

items.t: Police search for suspects who stole 3,000 pounds of snow crab legs in Philadelphia
items.x: Police in Philadelphia are searching for a group of six men who they say stole 3,000 pounds of snow crabs in a cargo heist.

items.t: Utah authorities are connecting serial killer Ted Bundy to another 1970s homicide
items.x: DNA connects serial killer Ted Bundy to the death of a Utah teenager, authorities announced Tuesday, more than 50 years after her body was discovered by a hunter.
